name: Zombie Juice
summary: Abercrombie sends travelers from his lonely shack in Duskwood to fetch Zombie Juice in Darkshire. He says the chill of the night leaves him cold.

sections.title: A Chilly Request
sections.body: Abercrombie lives alone among the horrors of Duskwood's shadowed woods and often sends sympathetic travelers on strange errands. He says the creeping dusk drains his warmth and vitality, then asks you to travel east to Darkshire. At the Scarlet Raven Tavern, Tavernkeep Smitts sells the potent drink Abercrombie seeks. Its ominous name is Zombie Juice, and Abercrombie says it will put fire back in his veins.

sections.title: At the Scarlet Raven
sections.body: Tavernkeep Smitts serves weary guards and frightened townsfolk at Darkshire's tavern, but few ask for Zombie Juice. The drink is known for its dangerous strength, and Smitts recognizes the vintage. Abercrombie's taste for such a morbid brew raises quiet eyebrows in a region besieged by the restless dead.

faq.answer: Zombie Juice is an exceptionally strong liquor with a morbid name, sold by Tavernkeep Smitts at the Scarlet Raven Tavern in Darkshire. Ordinary patrons rarely ask for it.

faq.q: Who sends you to fetch Zombie Juice?
faq.answer: The hermit Abercrombie sends you to fetch Zombie Juice. He lives alone in a shack in western Duskwood and says the drink will warm his cold bones.

faq.q: Where do you turn in the quest?
faq.answer: You speak with Tavernkeep Smitts inside the Scarlet Raven Tavern, Darkshire's central inn in eastern Duskwood.

aliases: why does he drink zombie juice
faq.answer: Abercrombie says Duskwood's gloomy, shadowed nights leave him shivering, and he needs the fiery drink to warm his blood.

faq.q: Is Tavernkeep Smitts surprised by the order?
faq.answer: Yes. Smitts says Zombie Juice is extraordinarily potent and that his regular customers rarely ask for it.

faq.q: Does this quest involve fighting any monsters?
faq.answer: No. You travel along the road from Abercrombie's secluded hut to Darkshire and speak with Tavernkeep Smitts. Duskwood's roads are also fraught with wandering beasts and undead.

angles.text: As an Alliance adventurer, you may carry messages for the eccentric recluses along Duskwood's perilous roads while supporting Darkshire's embattled outpost.
